name: Auto.dev Vehicle Data API
description:
Automotive data for developers and AI agents: VIN decoding, specifications, listings, photos, recalls, financing, taxes, and total cost of ownership. Every endpoint takes a VIN (or a US plate) and returns JSON.

## Authentication
Send your API key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (recommended), the `?apiKey=<key>` query parameter, or the `X-API-Key` header. Create keys in the dashboard at https://www.auto.dev/dashboard. Unauthenticated browser requests are redirected (302) to the sign-in page.

## Rate limits
Throughput is per plan. On 429, honor the `Retry-After` header.
- **Free:** 5 requests/second — 1,000 API calls / month
- **Growth:** 10 requests/second — Unlimited monthly volume
- **Scale:** 50 requests/second — Unlimited monthly volume

## Versioning & deprecation
The current major version is v2 (documented at https://docs.auto.dev). Breaking changes ship under a new major version. Endpoints scheduled for removal are announced in the docs and signaled at runtime with the `Deprecation` and `Sunset` response headers (RFC 8594) ahead of removal.

## Errors
Errors use `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with a machine-readable `code` and a human-readable `title`/`detail`.
